reviews.comment:
Soy socio del ACA más de 20 años cargo combustible allí en Avellaneda hace años ahora por una circunstancia especial de índole laboral,debo cargar de noche.El playero nocturno siempre evita cargarme por que dice que la Estacion  acepta solo debito Visa no Maestro. (No manejo efvo solo debito.)Hoy cargué de día temprano y los playeros me dijeron que no tienen ningún problema con las tarjetas de Debito. Consulta? Quien controla el manejo del playero nocturno allí? Una pena tener que andar usando otras estaciones teniendo esta en mi zona y de camino al trabajo.

(Translated by Google)
I'm an ACA member and have been filling up at their Avellaneda station for over 20 years. Now, due to a work-related situation, I have to fill up at night. The night attendant always avoids serving me because he says the station only accepts Visa debit cards, not Maestro. (I don't use cash, only debit.) Today I filled up early in the morning, and the attendants told me they have no problem with debit cards. My question is: Who is monitoring the night attendant's actions there? It's a shame to have to use other stations when this one is in my area and on my way to work.
